overview: No anticheat processes the title packet. The corpus is 'Title' keyword noise: inventory GUI titles (Hydro menus, TruthfulAC GUI menus, NCP InventoryListener, Arc InventoryListener, MinecraftAntiCheat MenuEvents), scoreboard and sidebar output (Shard), discord webhook labels (Negativity, FlopAC), and book-inventory code (Grim ExploitB, Peyang Books). The only packet-shaped hits are Artemis's five wrapper interfaces (PacketPlayServerTitle, TitlesClear, TitlesSetAnimation, TitlesSetSubtitle, TitlesSetText) plus its PacketRepository registration (SERVER_PLAY + 75), and the Negativity PacketType TITLE constant; none of these consume or validate the packet. Titles are cosmetic, unacknowledged and carry no timing or state the server re-checks, so there is nothing to flag.
